verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Identity Verification integrates with Monitor, a separate Plaid product, to check users against watchlists and PEP lists. Nothing documents ongoing re-screening of previously verified users when watchlists change. The documented IDV webhooks (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) cover verification session progress, not watchlist-change hits, so they do not satisfy the event part of the story.

support.subject: As an ops lead, screening is not one-shot — previously verified users are continuously re-screened against watchlist updates, and changes raise events I can act on
